story_year_metric: Agreement with the experiment's date associations, not a claim that a time-travel film has only one canonical setting year

films.title: The Terminator
films.plot_reference: An assassin machine travels to the past to kill Sarah before she can give birth to the resistance leader. Kyle Reese is sent to protect her.

films.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
films.plot_reference: A reprogrammed machine protects young John Connor against the T-1000. John, Sarah, and their protector try to prevent the machine-led catastrophe.

films.title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
films.plot_reference: John and Kate are pursued by the T-X. A reprogrammed T-850 protects them as they seek to stop Skynet and ultimately survive the nuclear attack.

films.title: Terminator Salvation
films.experiment_condition: franchise control, absent from this training dataset
films.plot_reference: During the war against Skynet, John Connor and the human-machine hybrid Marcus Wright are drawn into a mission involving young Kyle Reese and the survival of the resistance.
films.notes: Release and named characters are catalogued by AFI. Broad plot relationships are curator-defined checks; the full summary remains available for review. The Arnold-unit role is unscored because of the brief digital likeness and multiple machines.

films.title: Terminator Genisys
films.plot_reference: Kyle arrives in an altered past where Sarah already has a machine guardian. They work together to prevent the future machine threat in a changed timeline.

films.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
films.plot_reference: Dani is hunted by the Rev-9. Sarah, the enhanced soldier Grace, and the machine Carl help protect her in a future shaped by a different hostile AI.
